Recommend **publish-witness-account**.

The **monastery testimony** gives the witness an existing basis independent of the council. Publishing that account creates a public record whose authority does not depend on council recognition. That matters because the **council’s public admission** was followed by the **council’s retraction**. A council hearing would return control of the response to the same institution that has already reversed its position.

The **forged founding record** and **named falsifier** can support the published account without making the council its judge.

The principal tradeoff is exposure. Publication protects the witness’s authority but increases the risk of retaliation against the witness.

I excluded the **broken lantern** because it does not affect who should control the response to the retraction. I also excluded motives, retaliation methods, and council procedures because none are accepted facts.

This recommendation is non-authoritative. It creates no canon, Book Direction, or Canonical State.
